combos.name: Hover preview stack
combos.blurb: hover.nvim is the shared preview host; these hand it something to draw without it needing to know the format itself.

combos.name: Markdown toolkit
combos.blurb: One document, several jobs: structure, list continuation, an external render, and decoration inside its code blocks.

combos.name: Statusline segments
combos.blurb: Each contributes one optional segment to ui.nvim's statusline -- none is a dependency, the segment is simply absent without it.

combos.name: Git family
combos.blurb: Git tooling for the editor: history and diffing, and the repo-health numbers around them.

combos.name: Diagnostics neighbors
combos.blurb: Related, not interchangeable -- each answers a different "what's going on" question (the editor, the program, the codebase, over time).
